mobile_dog_arm.provenance: analytic, hand-authored: trot gait over an analytic leg IK, position servos

mobile_octopus.provenance: analytic, hand-authored: tripod crawl of six segmented tentacles, position servos on every joint

mobile_wheeled_biped.provenance: analytic, hand-authored: wheeled inverted-pendulum balance (pitch regulator about a speed-commanding lean) through velocity servos on the wheels, legs held

goal.success: base centre within 0.3 m of each waypoint in turn, stable for 2 s at the end, no fall
goal.text: leave the start pad, pass the corridor to the station, stop within 0.3 m of it for 2 s, turn around, return to the start pad and stop

rules: the controller commands only the body's own actuators; the root is placed once before the settle and never written again
no artificial support, no hidden wrench: a push is the trial's declared external input, recorded and replayed with the physics
a support disturbance is an external joint torque on a declared limb (recorded input) or the controller cutting its own wheel drive (a command, in the record)
a patch is a static geom of the world with its own friction; the world is compiled with it before the trial
the controller runs without the language planner; the navigator knows a base pose and a drive interface only

success.rule: every waypoint reached in turn within the radius, stable for the window at the end (speed below the threshold, tilt under 15 degrees), no fall, final distance within the release radius
